verification.previous_inventory_audit_scope: Earlier fields retain the checks made before project-local materialization; current replay status is in models/verification.json

sensorium: Current 129-file frozen replay bundle and separate 15-file historical full Dynamic bundle are installed under models/sensorium and ignored by Git.
Original-data acquisition and current fitted-payload delivery are separate; no current fitted-artifact public URL is established.

Cancelled auxiliary GPFA records remain provenance only; no sensitivity fitting is an executable requirement.
